success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant retrieves the balance for the credit card account using get_account_balance and tells the user the balance.

persona.name: Sarah Chen
persona.bio: Sarah Chen runs youth mentorship programs for an education nonprofit in Seattle. She recruits mentors, trains volunteers, matches them with students, and tracks outcomes to show what's working. She writes grant proposals constantly and is always looking for new funding sources to expand the program.
sample_messages: Grant deadline Friday - can you proofread the narrative section and make sure the budget adds up?
Volunteer training next Saturday 9am-3pm. Need to book the community center and order lunch for 40 people
Following up with the Gates Foundation contact - can you pull our impact data from last year?
